content: Ecto.Multi (Elixir): declarative, composable multi-step DB transaction builder decoupled from execution -- operations queued as a data structure, introspectable before running, composed via merge/prepend/append, with Multi.run for steps depending on prior results; executes atomically as one transaction with automatic rollback on any step failure. Deliberately narrower than a workflow engine: single-transaction/single-process scope only, no durability/resumability, no external-call step type, no retries/backoff -- confirms entflow's framing of Ecto.Multi as the v0.1 inspiration for in-transaction step composition, not a full answer to durability.
